entities.summary: UNICEF estimates 650 million women alive today were married before age 18. Child marriage rates are declining but remain high in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. The UN Sustainable Development Goals target elimination by 2030. Despite laws, enforcement is weak — poverty and cultural norms drive the practice.
